title: Quantitative assessment of perirenal fat density in renal cell carcinoma: a combined radiologist-driven and YOLO-based CT study.
summary: YOLOv8-based normalized PRFD assessment compared with radiologist manual measurements in 57 RCC cases and 82 controls; upper-pole PRFD differences at left/right (p=.032/.040); model measurements broadly agree with manual assessment depending on attenuation normalization. Article AI statement also discloses QuillBot copyediting, but that is not the claimed result.
ai_technology: YOLO-derived normalized perirenal-fat measurements support an RCC-associated imaging phenotype; cross-sectional density differences do not establish causation or clinical utility.
